Pinned in environment-spec.md. Server-side only: it is present on the estate member server and absent on the client guest, so a lane may use it to author or inspect a topology but may not rely on it as a client-side oracle.

Recorded, not qualified (changed 2026-07-29): no current lane executes LGPO, so its hash is provenance only. Ruled 2026-08-03 that placing LGPO.exe on the estate is acceptable — disposable, checkpoint-backed guests, and the isolation invariant governs egress rather than what is deliberately placed inside — so WP-5 keeps its LGPO leg and this row is not pending because the tool was ruled out. It is pending because qualification is earned by execution: WP-5 must push the binary post-restore, verify it on the guest against a pinned SHA-256, and only then restore the check in frozen_environment_violations(). Do not flip this row on the strength of the ruling alone.

tools.notes: Requalified by the WI-059 computer and user RSoP scenarios on the 26200 client. The client has no GroupPolicy module. Computer capture explicitly selects /scope:computer; user capture selects /scope:user /user <principal> and requires a verified interactive session. Qualification requires the output artifact, not merely exit zero.

Not used by any lane, and the reason is worth keeping. This row stood in for the user-scope gap: WP-6 forbids an interactive `whoami /groups` as the computer token, and the collection it described rode an interactive logon the estate did not have. The estate has one now (windows-evidence-lab, the `user-logged-on` checkpoint), and WP-9 was built without whoami: the principal's SID comes from an NTAccount translation, the winning values from the loaded hive at HKEY_USERS\<SID>, and the resultant set from gpresult /scope:user /user <principal>. Kept as a row rather than deleted so the gate it represented is visibly closed rather than quietly removed.

All ten finalizers and the shared source-byte guard are bound by (commit, path, sha256) in the 22 passing Plan 034 batch runs at 263f19640529d469c2a54c18b43d228db5378279 and the object-security successor at 1fb3f56ac7431e0044c69c32edc4350b2ab84151. lanes.oracle: LGPO import, policy refresh, direct registry API reads, and GroupPolicy operational events on a snapshot-backed endpoint, plus domain-GPO processing through the verified WP-2 path.
lanes.notes: Hosts qualified 2026-08-03; now blocked only on lgpo, which the 2026-08-03 ruling keeps in the lane rather than narrowing it away. The binary must be pushed post-restore over psdirect and hash-verified on the guest, so no golden checkpoint carries it. The domain-GPO leg is the one that tests Studio (its output reaching a client through SYSVOL); the LGPO leg mostly tests Microsoft's tool, and WP-5 acceptance requires both.

lanes.oracle: gpresult.exe /x <file> /f /scope:computer on the client, parsed from the http://www.microsoft.com/GroupPolicy/Rsop namespace, plus direct winning-registry reads, GroupPolicy operational events, LDAP tokenGroups via [adsisearcher] for the computer token, and Get-Acl / Get-GPPermission -All for effective rights.
lanes.notes: Requalified 2026-10-08 at 263f19640529d469c2a54c18b43d228db5378279 by rsop-observe-20261008075254-6590, rsop-observe-20261008075447-5315, rsop-observe-20261008075636-2267, rsop-observe-20261008075825-8227, rsop-observe-20261008080014-9153, rsop-observe-20261008081929-9918, rsop-observe-20261008080205-6689. The seven computer scenarios cover precedence, block/enforcement/disabled links, true/false/error WMI outcomes, allow/read-only/deny filtering, group deny, and deny Read. The group-denial case reboots and verifies a refreshed machine token. Applied-GPO comparison and direct winning-registry reads are gated; neither can substitute for the other. The client uses gpresult because its GroupPolicy module is absent. SearchedSOM freshness is not graded; WI-028 requires separate scoping evidence.

lanes.oracle: gpresult.exe /x <file> /f /scope:user /user <DOMAIN>\<principal> on the client, parsed from the http://www.microsoft.com/GroupPolicy/Rsop namespace's UserResults section, plus the winning HKCU values read from the principal's loaded hive at HKEY_USERS\<SID>, plus GroupPolicy operational events -- 8005 for the completion of the principal's own processing pass, and 5311 for the loopback mode Windows actually used.
lanes.notes: Requalified 2026-10-08 at 263f19640529d469c2a54c18b43d228db5378279 by rsop-user-observe-20261008080357-2733, rsop-user-observe-20261008080612-1816, rsop-user-observe-20261008080829-2986, rsop-user-observe-20261008081133-5663, rsop-user-observe-20261008081431-2742, rsop-user-observe-20261008081652-5582. Six scenarios cover loopback merge/replace, disabled user side, allow/read-only/group filtering, explicit deny Apply and deny Read. Applied-GPO comparison is gated (WI-032); winning values are read from the principal's loaded HKEY_USERS hive. Event 5311 verifies loopback mode and a mode mismatch is inconclusive. Group cases restart the client and verify the new session token contains the authored group. A verified console session is required. User-side WMI outcomes and slow-link processing remain outside scope; SearchedSOM freshness is not graded.

lanes.oracle: For each case, a GPMC-format backup carrying fdeploy1.ini and the fdeploy.ini marker is imported with Import-GPO into a disposable unlinked GPO. SYSVOL is read back, a fresh Get-GPOReport -ReportType Xml is taken and Backup-GPO re-exports the GPO. The re-exported files must be byte-identical to the candidate's, and Studio's read_backup over Windows' own backup must agree with the report's FolderRedirectionSettings rows (folder id, principal SID, destination path). The expectation is built on the controller and never reaches the guest.
lanes.notes: Certified 2026-10-08 at 6b76fad177183999cab7b2bdf35d16baf8fed014 by fd-20261008102559-9746 (29/29). Four cases: R3's GPMC-written bytes verbatim (Flags 1021) and three builder-written Flags-only variants (1020, 1023, 3069); one folder (Documents), one principal (Everyone), one path. Certifies the reader's agreement with Windows for these shapes only. Flags is carried, not decoded: Windows' option rendering per value is recorded, not asserted (WI-066 data). Multi-folder and multi-principal documents, other Flags values, the writer (WI-066/R12) and endpoint application are not covered. One build (WS2025 26100) was measured.
